events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: A Slanderous Plot

options.text: Send [character] to spread damaging lies about [character].
No, I will think of some other plot against [character].

events.text: You cast a wary eye on the eminence of [character], the leader of the [rival]. [character] has offered to help you scheme against your rival by conducting a Slander mission to ruin the reputation of [character] and his people. Will you send [character] to slander the good name of the [rival]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: A Slanderous Plot

options.text: Help [character] to spread damaging lies about [character] and the [rival].
Shame on you for planning such a lowly scheme!

events.text: [character] is plotting against [character], the leader of the [rival], and wants our help with his schemes. [character] suggests that we ought to send [character] on a Slander mission to ruin the reputation of [character]. Will you send [character] to slander the good name of the [rival]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Angry Acolytes

options.text: We will send out [character] to pacify [city].
Let them stew in their anger. I will not grovel to my own subjects!

events.text: The Discontent among [religion] in [city] has boiled over into violent protests! [character] believes that we can quell the anger of any religious mobs in [city] through a Pacify City mission. Shall we send [character] to address the grievances of the [religion] in [city]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Diplomacy Through Trade

options.text: I would like to help establish diplomatic relations through a Trade Mission.
This is not the way I wish to conduct diplomacy.

events.text: Ambassador [character] believes that we can further establish our diplomatic relations with the [rival] through commerce, and has drawn up plans for a Trade Mission to their capital. Shall we approve his plan to execute a trade deal?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Enlightened Rival

options.text: Send [character] to steal research from the [rival].
We will not resort to theft!

events.text: [character] has come to you with intriguing news. A rival leader, [character], has discovered so many technologies that he is now known as Enlightened. [character] thinks we could benefit from stealing some of his research. He has formulated a technological espionage plan to close the gap between us and [character], and is eager for your approval.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Family Intercession

options.text: Have [character] intercess upon [character] on my behalf.
I'm too busy for that at the moment.

events.text: [character] is distressed at the falling out between yourself and his fellow [family] Family member [character]. It does not reflect well on his leadership as Oligarch for other [family] to be at odds with the crown, and he would like to intercede on your behalf. This would hopefully improve your relationship with [character]. Shall [character] set out on this Intercession Family Mission?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Imprison Mission

options.text: Imprison [character]!
Let's find another way of resolving my differences with [character].

events.text: [character] is quite upset with you. Your Chancellor, [character], has quietly suggested that you might conduct an Imprison Mission to get him out of the way. This won't do much to improve his opinion of you, but it will make him less able to interfere in your affairs. Shall you Imprison [character]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Inciting Unrest

options.text: We will task [character] with inciting an Insurrection through his Agent Network in [city].
No, I don't feel comfortable with inciting Insurrection in [city].

events.text: [character], our Agent in [city], has established an Agent Network in the city and is now poised to conduct an Insurrection Mission there. Shall we approve of his plan to foment Insurrection in [city]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Influence Mission

options.text: I see some profit in improving relations with [character].
I'm too busy for that at the moment.

events.text: Recently, you've been thinking about improving relations with [character]. Who knows what benefits such a friendship could bring? An Influence Mission could help you accomplish this goal. Shall you set out to Influence [character], and thereby improve his opinion of you?

events.name: Making Amends

options.text: Let us reconcile and exchange gifts with the [family].
Let them stew in their anger. I will not grovel to my own subjects!

events.text: The [family] family are making no secret of their anger towards you! However, Chancellor [character] believes that we can improve relations with the [family] through a Family Gift mission. Shall we follow the advice of [character] and send a gift to the [family]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Plotting Neighbor

options.text: Infiltrate the court of [character] and the [rival] to uncover any plots.
No, I trust our neighbors.

events.text: [character] has caught wind of a plot by [character] to scheme against us! [character] suggests that we send [character] on an Infiltrate mission to see if there is any truth to the rumors. With your blessing, [character] is ready to execute such a mission.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Propitiation

options.text: Let us give gifts to the [family] to please the [religion].
Let these theocrats ask the gods for gifts.

events.text: The family of [character], the [family], feel that you have been neglecting them despite the fact that [character] is the head of your State Religion, [religion]. Your Chancellor [character] believes that we ought to reach out to the [family]. He suggests sending them Family Gift. Shall we follow the advice of [character]?

events.name: Quelling Unrest

events.text: The Discontent in [city] may soon get out of hand. [character] believes that we can quell any unrest in [city] through a Pacify City mission. Shall we send [character] to hear the grievances of [city]?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Religious Intercession

options.text: Have [character] intercess upon [character] on my behalf.
I'm too busy for that at the moment.

events.text: [character] feels that [character]'s zealotry for the faith of [religion] has been waning recently. He would like to intercede on your behalf, and thereby help to improve your relationship with [character]. Shall [character] set out on this Intercession Religion Mission?

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: Smear Campaign

options.text: Weave a web of lies and slander about [character] and the [rival].
We will not stoop so low!

events.text: [character] has come to you with alarming news! A rival leader, [character], has grown quite illustrious and is now known as Great! [character] thinks we ought to take him down a peg. He has formulated a plan to viciously slander [character], and is eager for your approval.

[character] has formulated a strategic espionage plan to steal research from the [rival] and, with your approval, will make preparations to execute the mission.
